findings.location: All five specs section B prayer-browser-observation/v1; R0002.md:57 and R0003/R0006/R0007.md:58; same comment copies/metadata observer contract.
findings.claim: The post-render observation contract is described as reading selected read-only state, but requests qaState().dateTruth/wxTruth while measuring storage/write/ownership effects.
findings.observedSourceFact: qaState() config diagnostic invokes SalahConfig.storageAvailable(); it setItem('__sw_probe__','1') and removeItem('__sw_probe__'). No probe separation/exclusion is specified by these plans.
findings.failureMode: Every observer snapshot introduces storage operations into the log that is intended to discriminate product cache/config/obsolete-write behavior, and adds reads/recomputations beyond last-painted state. An executor can produce false write failures or incorrectly call the observer side-effect-free. This is a harness contract defect, not a new production runtime finding.
findings.smallestCorrection: Read _lastDateTruth and narrowly chosen direct read-only actual weather decision/diagnostic fields inside the checked IIFE observation hook, without calling full qaState in cache/effect windows. Alternatively explicitly segregate any qaState diagnostic call outside measured product-effect windows, tag and retain its '__sw_probe__' writes/removal separately and keep raw logs; never erase actual product writes. Add the same rule to observer metadata/comment copies and preserve no observer-induced source/state mutation.
findings.recheck: Hash-bound read-only review of the corrected common observer contract and all five synchronized spec/comment/metadata artifacts; no product/browser rerun required for the plan correction.
